name: OWASP Top 10 (2021)
description: The ten most critical web-application security risk categories from the OWASP Top 10 (2021 edition), expressed as controls in the Cerberus catalog schema. Requirement text is a concise summary written for this catalog, not the OWASP wording; see https://owasp.org/Top10/ for the authoritative descriptions.

controls.title: Broken Access Control
controls.requirement: Enforce authorization server-side on every request, deny by default, and prevent users from acting outside their intended permissions (including direct object references and privilege escalation).

controls.title: Cryptographic Failures
controls.requirement: Protect sensitive data in transit and at rest with current, strong algorithms and protocols; do not use deprecated hashes or ciphers, and do not disable certificate validation.

controls.title: Injection
controls.requirement: Keep untrusted data separate from commands and queries: use parameterized interfaces, validate input, and avoid dynamic code or shell execution built from user-controlled data.

controls.title: Insecure Design
controls.requirement: Apply secure design practices: threat modeling, secure design patterns, and reference architectures, so that security controls are designed in rather than added after implementation.

controls.title: Security Misconfiguration
controls.requirement: Harden every layer of the stack: remove unused features and default accounts, keep security settings enabled, and apply a repeatable, reviewed configuration process across environments.

controls.title: Vulnerable and Outdated Components
controls.requirement: Maintain an inventory of components and their versions, monitor them for known vulnerabilities, and upgrade or patch them in a timely manner.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication Failures
controls.requirement: Protect authentication: support multi-factor authentication, resist credential stuffing and brute force, manage sessions securely, and never ship default or hardcoded credentials.

controls.title: Software and Data Integrity Failures
controls.requirement: Verify the integrity of code, dependencies, updates, and serialized data; secure the CI/CD pipeline against unauthorized changes.

controls.title: Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
controls.requirement: Log security-relevant events such as logins, access-control failures, and high-value transactions with enough context to investigate, and monitor and alert on them.

controls.title: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
controls.requirement: Validate and restrict any server-side fetch of a user-supplied URL: enforce allowlists, block internal address ranges, and segment network access for fetching services.
